guide.priorLine: @footmercato is a general French-market football news wire covering mercato, FIFA governance, and match results across many clubs, so Barcelona-specific items are rare exceptions rather than the norm.

onBeatPatterns.pattern: Transfer/price update specifically about a Barça target or outgoing player
examplesEnglish: Barça knows the price to pay for Ounahi
Barça wants at least €55 million for Ferran Torres
FC Barcelona wants to copy Real Madrid's model

offBeatPatterns.pattern: Real Madrid transfer/player-drama rumor with no Barça angle
examplesEnglish: The colossal price of Vinicius Jr's possible transfer to Arsenal
Vinicius Jr will have to explain himself to José Mourinho!

offBeatPatterns.pattern: PSG mercato dossier update (Godts, Suzuki, Akliouche, Kolo Muani, etc.)
examplesEnglish: PSG has made a first offer of €45M for Mika Godts
PSG: medical this Sunday for Randal Kolo Muani at Juventus
'Don't destroy the evidence': UEFA threatens Gianni Infantino with legal action!
FIFA: Gianni Infantino was aiming for an XXL salary

offBeatPatterns.pattern: Other clubs' signing/loan/mercato news unrelated to Barça
examplesEnglish: Giovanni Reyna will sign for Strasbourg

offBeatPatterns.pattern: Friendly or cup match result recap for non-Barça clubs
examplesEnglish: Friendly: Liverpool suffers a heavy defeat against Leeds
AZ Alkmaar humiliates PSV in the Dutch Super Cup final
